_note: APPROXIMATION of the mid-term model on the v2 split, NOT RUN. The mid-term runner (tag midterm-eval, experiments/run_cordex_experiment.py) hard-codes its split (train 1961-1975, val 1976-1980, test 1981-2000), so it cannot use the v2 split. This config instead runs run_cordex_v2.py with every fix switched off and the mid-term hyperparameters. Known remaining differences: BGNet(-) is trained here (the mid-term silently skipped it; it needs bgnet_minus_padding 'same' on 16x16), the BGNet baseline here has the members' architecture (the mid-term baseline used larger defaults: channels 64/128/256, dense 256), the fixed test-data fallbacks, and best-weight restoring at the epoch cap. Use: python experiments/run_cordex_v2.py --config configs/cordex_midterm_on_v2_split.json
